nested_tuning_config.protocol: Nested Cross-Validation with Repeated Stratified K-Fold Outer Evaluation
nested_tuning_config.outer_cv: 5 folds x 5 repeats (25 outer evaluations, random_state=42)

Function Class.clinical_meaning: NYHA heart failure functional classification (0=asymptomatic to 3=severe)
Function Class.encoding: StandardScaler numeric continuum (monotonic functional capacity score)

Region RWMA.clinical_meaning: Count of regional wall motion abnormality echocardiographic segments
Region RWMA.encoding: StandardScaler numeric continuum (discrete segmental severity count)

VHD.encoding: OneHotEncoder(drop='first', handle_unknown='ignore') nominal dummy indicators (VHD_mild, VHD_Moderate, VHD_Severe)

BBB.encoding: OneHotEncoder(drop='first', handle_unknown='ignore') nominal dummy indicators (BBB_LBBB, BBB_RBBB)
